statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Nasdaq-100 futures are reported little changed after the Sunday reopen while oil remains elevated; no fresh evidence establishes persistent one-way NQ structure.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail remains below the blocking threshold; persistent mean-reversion failure after weak or failed retracements is the conditional escalation checkpoint.
headline: Nasdaq Tail eases within WATCH as futures stay near flat
body: Fresh Asian-session reporting shows Nasdaq-100 futures little changed despite renewed U.S.-Iran shipping attacks and elevated crude, while Japanese chip shares are stronger. The evidence supports extreme Stress but not a current pathological one-way NQ path. The narrow conditional danger window is the Labor Day evening futures reopen.

lookbackSummary: All 24 prior UTC clock-hour assessments are available. Tail stayed in WATCH at 21-24% through September 6 and eased to 22% by the 23:00 and 00:00 UTC assessments while Stress remained extreme.
outlookSummary: Tail remains WATCH through most of the Labor Day session if NQ continues to permit repair. The conditional danger window centers on the 22:00 UTC futures reopen, where a gap plus failed repair and repeated extension could move Tail into the elevated band.

forecast.analysis: Current: Nasdaq-100 futures are reported little changed while Brent and WTI remain elevated on renewed U.S.-Iran shipping attacks; rising Japanese chip shares add cross-asset conflict. No fresh evidence shows persistent one-way NQ structure.
drivers: Elevated Brent/WTI on U.S.-Iran shipping escalation

news.title: Asian Stocks to Gain, Oil Rises on US-Iran Strikes: Markets Wrap
Oil extends gains after US and Iran strike ships

forecast.analysis: If early Asia remains two-sided, Tail stays near 20; repeated NQ extension with shallow or failed pullbacks would be the escalation condition.
Asia follow-through would keep Tail contained if NQ repairs directional pushes; oil-led repricing without equity persistence mainly sustains Stress.
Tokyo strength can offset some headline pressure, but a synchronized NQ decline with poor retracement quality would raise path risk.
Before Europe participates, thinner liquidity can exaggerate moves; Tail stays low-watch unless repeated extension survives meaningful repair attempts.
At the Asia-to-Europe handoff, Tail rises slightly because cross-market confirmation could strengthen; two-sided NQ discovery would keep it contained.

news.title: Oil extends gains after US and Iran strike ships

forecast.analysis: European pre-open conditions remain a confirmation test: aligned oil, yields and weak NQ retracements would matter more than move size alone.
Europe's opening hour is a checkpoint for breadth and rate sensitivity; absent persistent directional efficiency, Tail remains in WATCH.
European cash flow can amplify the overnight signal. A sustained NQ move that holds near extremes would raise Tail; rotational trade would not.
Mid-morning Europe keeps Tail in WATCH unless failed NQ retracements combine with renewed oil or yield acceleration.
With U.S. cash markets closed for Labor Day, normal New York confirmation is absent; headline shocks can raise Stress without proving Tail behavior.

news.title: Oil extends gains after US and Iran strike ships

forecast.analysis: Late European morning remains a structure test. Meaningful NQ pullbacks or gap repair would keep Tail below the blocking threshold.
Approaching U.S. holiday hours, reduced participation can widen swings; persistence across multiple retracement attempts is the key Tail checkpoint.
European midday raises conditional Tail slightly because liquidity can thin further; one-way continuation would need cross-asset confirmation.
Into the U.S. holiday window, directional headlines may produce larger moves, but two-sided repair would keep Tail in WATCH.

news.title: Oil extends gains after US and Iran strike ships

forecast.analysis: Before the scheduled NQ matching halt, Tail stays WATCH unless price repeatedly extends after weak pullbacks with oil/yields aligned.
During the scheduled Labor Day halt in NQ matching, immediate path risk is lower but gap risk can accumulate from geopolitical and energy headlines.
With NQ matching still halted, Tail remains WATCH as an accumulation-risk state; no future gap direction is assumed.
Later in the halt, unresolved Gulf or rate news could enlarge reopen risk, but direction remains unknown until trading resumes.
One hour before the regular evening reopen, Tail rises within WATCH because accumulated headlines may be repriced into a thinner reopening book.
Pre-reopen risk reaches the top of WATCH; the key future test is whether any opening gap repairs quickly or instead becomes directionally efficient.

forecast.analysis: At the scheduled 22:00 UTC reopen, Tail is conditionally elevated: a gap that resists repair, shallow pullbacks and repeated extension would justify the block state.
During the first full post-reopen hour, continued one-way structure with failed retracements would keep Tail elevated; rapid repair or two-sided trade would invalidate it.
By the second post-reopen hour, Tail remains conditionally elevated only if the directional path is still efficient and cross-assets continue to reinforce it.
